scientific_integrity: All central group-theoretic premises are cited by theorem and inspected in their open full texts. Six exact small-curve computations and 500 cyclic checks corroborate but do not replace the general proof. Independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Smooth plane cubics over finite fields with a rational flex and rational-point count divisible by three; no classification outside this arithmetic range, or of all optimal covers. General proof invokes two credited published finite-group existence theorems. Historical priority is not independently certified.
title: Exact rational-line covers of plane elliptic cubics at point counts divisible by three
